title: Heavenly Experience
text:
Alberto gives you a very personalized experience for a small group and no waiting in lines. Our Lady of Montserrat will not disappoint.! 
The hike was absolutely breathtaking. Alberto is an amazing guide and knowledgeable. His Renault van  is clean, comfortable and has air conditioning.
author: Anne_M

title: Unforgettable Day / Expert Guide
author: Kristen_M

title: Enjoyable time in Montserrat
text: We enjoyed our visit to Montserrat and the wonderful hiking trail . The hike is not super hard- but the trail is rocky and you should have good shoes . Don’t training flip flops!
author: Ellen_W

title: Montserrat
text:
This Montserrat tour was one of the best experiences of my life. Our guide, Albert, was fantastic—knowledgeable, engaging, and made the whole day feel seamless.

While you can definitely visit Montserrat on your own, the convenience of being picked up and having everything organized was a huge highlight. It made the experience so much more relaxing and enjoyable.

The views and hiking were absolutely incredible—something I’ll never forget. Highly recommend!
author: SAMANTHA_F

title: A highlight of our trip!
text:
This was a highlight of our trip! Being able to see the Abbey with almost no other visitors early in the morning was so peaceful. Our guide Albert was great, proving the context and history of the abbey. 

In our opinion, the best part is the hike through the mountains. The mountains side and views from the top are really something else - a beautiful way to take in all the natural beauty.  Here too Albert was a great guide! High energy and clearly a passion for the outdoors.

author: Emma_B

title: We climbed a mountain!
text: Albert was a very knowledgeable about the history and was an excellent and safe guide on the hike. The views on the hike were just amazing and breathtaking. The hike can be difficult at times so highly recommend you are in good condition for the hike. Albert took us to a small town after our hike, where we were able to have as small snack and enjoy a glass of wine. If you have time during your stay in Barcelona, I highly recommend this experience. You won't regret it.
author: Donna_M

title: Montserrat early morning hiking tour
text: The tour was breathtakingly awesome! The tour started early and on time. There was no problem going to the pick up point because Albert, the tour leader was giving us updates ahead of time. Albert went above and beyond during the tour. He made us all safe during hiking of Montserrat. He’s very professional and friendly. He also gave us some history and insights about Monserrat and the monastery. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to experience a hiking adventure and breathtaking sceneries of Montserrat.
author: Marcelo_A

title: Amazing hiking adventure!
text: This is the Montserrat tour to book! The hike is the main feature, and it was an amazing adventure! Be prepared to do a little amateur rock climbing up a ravine if you want the most spectacular view! (You can also choose not to do the most strenuous climbs) Albert is fun and very knowledgable. PS. it can be extremely windy on the mountain, so wear layers if the morning is cold!
author: Lyndsay_B

title: Incredible sunrise and hiking
text: I highly recommend this experience to see an incredible sunrise, beat the crowds and see amazing viewpoints. Albert was very responsive and helpful leading up to the trip and confirmed convenient pickup points near our hotel. THE DRIVE: The van was spacious and comfortable. Albert is a speedy driver up that mountain so be prepared for a wild ride. I recommend Dramamine if you get carsick easily- lots of twists and turns up and down the mountain road. THE WEATHER: It was quite chilly and windy the day we were there in January so dress in layers. The sunrise was breathtaking! THE BASILICA VISIT:
author: Kendra_F

title: We are happy to visit...
text: We are happy to visit this place. With such an inspiring guide as Albert, this morning at the monastery was unforgettable. The hiking was interesting: magical mountains, beautiful clouds.
